items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Well how do you rate Ray Burke? ... he is probably one of the most original, certainly the most original creative artist in New Orleans at this time. ... while he is always a fabulous hand to have on a session

ctx.x: Yeah, I find that, in a way, how many, I find this hard to sort out in my mind, because I'm trying to sort out all the different Wiggs's in my mind, and your opinion of the different Wiggs's, our opinions.

Well, of course I always like Wiggs better when he gets the Davenport out of the horn. And I have found that in the right kind of a musical environment he does that. It always seems to me that he plays like Oliver when he's happy and like Bix when he's mad. And I find even that interesting, and I found Bix interesting enough. But, I'm not excited by that, you know, I'm not excited by that. I'm more excited by that, you know, I'm more interested than excited by that. But of course Wiggs, you see, having gone…
a jazz organization. You could listen to him as a solo I see.
